title: fzf's key bindings on the packaged fish, which claim keys in every bind mode
notes: These widgets claim keys in every bind mode this shell ships, including the one this session would bind a sequence in to leave the reader waiting for another key. The takeover is driven on this shell under its own bindings in the plain case instead.

plugin.probe: echo kr-plugin=(functions -q fzf-file-widget; and echo on; or echo off)
